lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I will serve Thee,
Because I love Thee,
You have given life to me,
I was nothing,
Before you found me,
You have given life to me,
Heartaches, broken pieces,
Ruined lives are why
You died on Calvary,
Your touch is what I long for,
You have given life to me.
